# routeros_ipv6_dhcp_relay_option (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (Number) DHCPv6 option code. DHCPv6 option codes are 16 bit wide ([RFC 8415](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8415)); the built-in `client_mac` entry uses code 79 (OPTION_CLIENT_LINKLAYER_ADDR).
- `name` (String) Descriptive name of the option.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `only_if_mac_available` (Boolean) Insert the option only when the MAC address of the client is known to the relay, that is, when the client is directly attached to the relay.
- `value` (String) Parameter's value. Available data types for options are:
    - `'test'` -> ASCII to Hex 0x74657374
    - `s'160'` -> ASCII to Hex 0x313630
    - `'10'` -> Decimal to Hex 0x0a
    - `0x0a0a` -> No conversion
    - `$(VARIABLE)` -> hardcoded values

Data types can be combined, the built-in `client_mac` option is defined as `0x0001$(CLIENT_MAC)`.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_value` (String) Read-only field which shows the raw DHCP option value (the format actually sent out).
